title: DjangoCon 2022 | From React to htmx on a real-world SaaS product: we did it, and it's awesome!
summary: David Guillot describes how his team replaced a two-year-old React UI of their SaaS product with Django templates and htmx in a couple of months. The talk gives concrete indicators on code size, performance and team impact.
why: HN commenters point to it as a real-world case study of moving from React to htmx, especially in threads on boring web development and HTML over the wire.

quote.text: This recent talk from Djangocon "React to htmx on a real-world SaaS product" might be of interest
